newsitem.title: USA: U.S West Coast jet fuel continues steady climb.
newsitem.headline: U.S West Coast jet fuel continues steady climb.

text.p: U.S. West Coast jet fuel prices moved higher on Friday, continuing a steady climb since midweek on tighter supplies in the region, traders said.
"It's been moving up for a couple of days. There's a good demand for supply," one trader said.
Gasoline prices in Los Angeles and San Francisco were weaker in morning discussion, with falling NYMEX prices putting downward pressure on West Coast spot prices as trade wound down for the week.
"The Merc is coming off a little bit. We'll see what happens," another trader said.
Jet fuel was talked two cents higher at bids of 83 cents a gallon in L.A. and 82 cents a gallon in the Bay Area, traders said.
CARB gasoline was talked 80/81 cents a gallon in L.A. and two cents weaker in San Francisco.
